title: Upon entering the mosque - Hisn al-Muslim 20
arabic: أَعوذُ باللهِ العَظيـم وَبِوَجْهِـهِ الكَرِيـم وَسُلْطـانِه القَديـم مِنَ الشّيْـطانِ الرَّجـيم، [ بِسْـمِ الله، وَالصَّلاةُ وَالسَّلامُ عَلى رَسولِ الله]، اللّهُـمَّ افْتَـحْ لي أَبْوابَ رَحْمَتـِك
transliteration: A'udhu billahi al-'adhim, wa bi-wajhihil-karim, wa sultanihil-qadim, min ash-shaytan ar-rajim. [Bismillahi, wassalatu wassalam 'ala rasulillahi.] Allahumaftah li 'abwaba rahmatik.
translation: I seek refuge in Almighty Allah, By His Noble Face, By His primordial power, From Satan the outcast. [In the Name of Allah, and blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open before me the doors of Your mercy.]
reference: Abu Dawud and Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir (Hadith no. 4591); Ibn As-Sunni (Hadith no. 88), graded good by Al-Albani; Abu Dawud 1/126; Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 1/528; Muslim 1/494; Sunan Ibn Majah
